For this story he wears source BLACK TOP HAT and BLACK TAILCOAT with red bowtie and blue waistcoat. His bare legs/feet remain where visible in source; do not replace visible skin with trousers. Mermaid: adult blonde, blue/cyan headband, green bikini top and emerald tail, smooth bright yellow hair. Preserve source face angle and eye visibility rather than copying the reference's upward gaze. Replace diagnostic red/white skin dithering with coherent peach fills. Preserve each hand attachment and the hidden far-side anatomy; do not add extra limbs or expose hidden eyes. The joined pair stays ONE silhouette.

His arms cradle her waist and the base of her green tail. Her near arm runs downward along her front to the supporting contact near waist; far arm hidden behind him. Her green tail curves from waist down-center then upward to the right, ending in large fin lobes projecting right. Johnny's coat sweeps left and one bare foot extends diagonally down-right; keep only source visible limbs. Preserve open negative space inside raised curved tail. Sparse arcs behind upper-right show spin, omit ground shadow.
Output: whole original body silhouette comfortably framed with transparent margins, no scenery, water, floor, labels, border, checkerboard, glow or ground shadows. Original rules over any prose ambiguity. Single drawing only.
